description: Activate when: user says 'how should we price our AI product?', 'per seat or per usage / per outcome?', 'how do we design pay-for-results pricing?', 'inference costs are eating our margin', 'price per resolution', or AI is shrinking the number of people a customer needs, so seat pricing has started to cannibalize itself. Do NOT activate when: the product's value has no measurable link to usage or outcomes (a flat platform subscription fits better); there are no paying customers and value is unproven (run pricing interviews first); the question is general price level, anchoring, or tiering rather than the AI charge unit (use pricing-strategy). More: deciqai.com/c/outcome-based-ai-pricing
